title: Feature
description: Schema for a compendium Feature entry (Rpg/Compendium/Features/Feature.cs). The compendium file should be a JSON object whose keys are feature IDs.

CommonFields.description: Fields shared by all feature types.

DoesGetAttackedBlock.description: Overrides whether an entity with this feature can be attacked.

reason.description: Reason shown when the attack is blocked.

DoesAttackBlock.description: Overrides whether this entity can perform an attack.

reason.description: Reason shown when the attack is blocked.

DoesExecuteSkillBlock.description: Overrides whether this entity can execute a skill.

reason.description: Reason shown when skill execution is blocked.

formula.description: The formula explaining what was changed

StatModifiers.description: Modifiers applied to one or more stats by this feature.

type.description: How to apply the modifier (add, multiply, etc).

skills.description: Skill compendium IDs granted by this feature.

doesGetAttacked.description:
Override for whether the entity can be attacked. 'reason' shown on block.
Caller is this entity, Target is the attacking entity. The variables available are:
$0 - Boolean representing whether the attack is currently hitting or not.
$1 - The attack's damage type.

doesAttack.description:
Override for whether this entity can attack. 'reason' shown on block.
Caller is this entity, Target is the attacked entity. The variables available are:
$0 - Boolean representing whether the attack is currently hitting or not.
$1 - The attack's damage type.

onExecuteSkill.description:
Effect applied when this entity executes a skill.
Caller is this entity, Target is the skill being executed. The variables available are:
$0 - The name of the skill.
$1...$n - The skill's arguments.

doesExecuteSkill.description:
Override for whether this entity can execute skills. 'reason' shown on block. 
Caller is this entity, Target is the skill being executed. The variables available are:
$0 - The name of the skill.
$1...$n - The skill's arguments.

receivingDamage.description:
Modifier applied to damage received by this entity. Caller is this entity, Target is the attacking entity. The variables available are:
$0 - The original damage amount.
$1 - The damage type.

attackingDamage.description:
Modifier applied to damage dealt by this entity. Caller is this entity, Target is the attacked entity. The variables available are:
$0 - The original damage amount.
$1 - The damage type.

onTick.description: Effect applied to the entity each tick while this feature is active.

onEnabled.description: Effect applied to the entity when this feature is enabled.

onDisabled.description: Effect applied to the entity when this feature is disabled.

onInjured.description:
Effect applied to the entity when it receives damage while this feature is active.
$0 - The injury's severity.
$1 - The injury's type id

toggleable.description: Whether this feature can be toggled on and off.

statModifiers.description: Stat modifiers applied by this feature.

defaultDuration.description: Number expression representing how many seconds is the default duration of this condition, if none was specified.

damage_type.description: Name of the DamageType applied each interval.
